Convert between SummarizedExperiment7 and RangedSummarizedExperiment7

Source: R/03-RangedSummarizedExperiment.R
toRangedSummarizedExperiment7.Rd

Explicit coercion functions, matching biocspec's toRangedSummarizedExperiment() and toSummarizedExperiment() methods (clauses RSE-COERCE-1/RSE-COERCE-2). Unlike the R/S4 original, assigning to rowRanges7<- never implicitly changes an object's class; these functions are the only way to move between the two classes. x must already be one of this package's S7 classes — to convert a Bioconductor S4 SummarizedExperiment or RangedSummarizedExperiment object, use asSummarizedExperiment7() first (these functions error if x is not already S7).

Usage

toRangedSummarizedExperiment7(x, rowRanges)

toSummarizedExperiment7(x)

Arguments

x

A SummarizedExperiment7 (for toRangedSummarizedExperiment7()) or RangedSummarizedExperiment7 (for toSummarizedExperiment7()).

rowRanges

The rowRanges7 to attach; its length must equal nrow(x).

Examples

se <- SummarizedExperiment7(assays = matrix(1:6, 2, 3), rowNames = c("g1", "g2"))
rse <- toRangedSummarizedExperiment7(se, rowRanges = list(1:10, 11:20))
rse
#> <RangedSummarizedExperiment7> 2 x 3
#> assays:  
#> rowRanges class: list 
#> colnames: 1, 2, 3 
back <- toSummarizedExperiment7(rse)
back
#> <SummarizedExperiment7> 2 x 3
#> assays:  
#> rownames: NULL 
#> colnames: 1, 2, 3
